[ PROFILE ]

About Bollam Rishithej

Indian deep-tech founder and operator. Managing Director of ML Dynamic Solutions, and a director and co-founder across ventures in agentic AI security, computer vision, electrochemical sensing, healthcare revenue intelligence, capital management and industrial operations.

Bollam Rishithej is an Indian founder and operator based in Hyderabad, Telangana. He holds a Master of Science in Entrepreneurship and Innovation Management from the University of Leicester (United Kingdom), where the work went on a business model for converting plastic waste into fuel. It never reached commercial deployment. That is the lesson he draws on most often: a good idea and a working business are separated by an enormous amount of unglamorous work, and almost everybody stops inside that gap.

He is Founder and Managing Director of ML Dynamic Solutions and holds board positions across twelve companies under the Companies Act, 2013 — spanning agentic AI security, computer vision, electrochemical sensing, healthcare revenue intelligence, capital management, bullion, infrastructure and food processing — and is Co-Founder and Chief Technology Officer of Emergera.ai in the United States. The breadth is structural rather than opportunistic. The engineering ventures are funded from the cash flow of operating businesses that already trade, which means a research timeline is set by the engineering rather than by someone else's fundraising calendar.

Several portfolio entities are recognised under the Government of India's DPIIT framework. Each of them enters its sector the same way: find one partner willing to run the system in live operation, build against that partner's actual constraints, deploy it where failure would be embarrassing, and only then call it a product. In education that partner is Deccan Springs Global School, Hyderabad, where the pilot is deployed under a signed memorandum of understanding.

[ DOCTRINE ]

01 / METHOD

One partner first

A sector is entered through a single committed pilot, built against its real constraints, and generalised only once the system has survived live operation. The second deployment is expected to break in ways the first did not.

02 / MODEL

Collaboration over capture

A category in an unorganised sector is built by several serious companies at once or it is not built at all. Laboratories, academic institutions and delivery partners are treated as collaborators whose own success has to be genuine.

[ THE INTENTION ]

Fifty thousand people employed, within ten years. Not users, not valuation — fifty thousand families with a salary because something we built exists.

That target shapes which sectors are worth entering: large, real, and organised well below what they are capable of. It is also why the work is deliberately non-competitive. In a sector that does not function yet, a second serious company is corroboration rather than a threat, and the ecosystem being stronger is worth more than any position within it.

The standard he works to is Ratan Tata’s — a company run as though it is accountable to the country it operates in, with returns as the consequence of doing that properly rather than the purpose of it. The reasoning is set out here.

[ COMMON QUESTIONS ]

Who is Bollam Rishithej?
Bollam Rishithej is an Indian deep-tech founder and operator based in Hyderabad, Telangana. He is Founder and Managing Director of ML Dynamic Solutions, and holds board positions across thirteen entities spanning agentic AI security, computer vision, electrochemical sensing, healthcare revenue intelligence, capital management, executive networks and industrial operations.
What is Bollam Rishithej’s role at ML Dynamic Solutions?
He is Founder and Managing Director. Under section 203 of the Companies Act, 2013 a person may hold only one whole-time key managerial personnel office, and ML Dynamic Solutions is his.
Which companies is Bollam Rishithej a director of?
ML Dynamic Solutions, ML Group of Companies, ML Capital, VidyuthLabs Technologies, Predictera, FirstSecure.ai, DenyFix.ai, CXOera, and the industrial companies Akshara Groups Bullion, Jenani Infra, Aditya Trading Company and RS Food Products — twelve directorships under the Companies Act, 2013. He is additionally Co-Founder and Chief Technology Officer of Emergera.ai, a United States LLC outside that Act.
What did Bollam Rishithej study?
He holds an MSc in Entrepreneurship and Innovation Management from the University of Leicester in the United Kingdom.
What is Bollam Rishithej’s vision?
To have fifty thousand people employed within ten years through the ventures he builds and backs — a measure of families supported rather than valuation. He works to a collaborative rather than competitive model, entering unorganised sectors through a single committed pilot partner and generalising only once the system survives live operation.
Where is Bollam Rishithej based?
Hyderabad, Telangana, India.
Is Bollam Rishithej the same person as Rishithej Bollam?
Yes. The name appears as Bollam Rishithej, Rishithej Bollam, Rishi Bollam and Bollam Rishi Thej across public records and press; they refer to the same person.

His ventures are listed in the portfolio, his career in the journey, and the full record in the executive dossier.
